title: Benchmark IHAVE pipeline end-to-end throughput
description:
Write an integration benchmark (not criterion — use a custom Tokio test harness) that connects a synthetic NNTP peer to a running transit instance and sends 10,000 IHAVE articles as fast as possible. Measures articles/second end-to-end including IPFS write and log append. Artifact: transit/benches/ihave_throughput.rs.

Acceptance criteria:
- benchmark reports articles/second
- IPFS mock or embedded node used (not real IPFS)
- result establishes the baseline before optimization
- benchmark is repeatable
